class.name: IfcFillAreaStyleTiles
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-46:1992 : The fill area style tiles defines a two dimensional tile to be used for the filling of annotation fill areas or other closed regions. The content of a tile is defined by the tile set, and the placement of each tile determined by the filling pattern which indicates how to place tiles next to each other.
